public_rationale: He frames the figure as his own estimate ('I see around $22 billion'). He gives no period, no definition of compute spend, and no method. No company or independent source publishes global AI compute spending outside OpenAI and Anthropic, and hyperscalers do not disclose AI revenue by customer. To test the number, an evaluator would have to choose a period and basis, such as one quarter or an annualized run rate. Earlier review found that choice unfair because the claim does not supply it. With no stated scope and no matching measure, the claim cannot fairly be scored as supported or contradicted.
limitations: A future disclosure of customer-level AI cloud revenue could make a rough check possible, but only if the period he meant became clear.
